component.name: Displays
component.summary: Arrange your displays and name the arrangements you use

description.p: When displays are plugged in together for the first time, Displays opens to ask how to use them: extend, mirror, or one display. Drag them to match your desk, and set rotation, refresh rate and scale where you can see the result.
Every arrangement you keep is remembered and can be named, like Home or Office.

screenshot.caption: Arrange displays with a responsive native interface
